attempts.summary: node1 now serves a signed local RPM repository at 10.100.112.10:8080. `localrepo-demo-1.0.0-1.el10` was installed from it while outbound HTTPS—and therefore the usual Red Hat repositories—was deliberately unreachable. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved, and the repository recovered after a verified node reboot. subscription-manager automatically regenerated redhat.repo during transactions; its managed status and enabled BaseOS/AppStream repositories remain intact.
